content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: HVPNL has released this notice for selection of apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, through the office of the Superintending Engineer/Transmission System (TS Circle), HVPNL Hisar. The notice specifies that the training period and training stipend of selected apprentices will be payable as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Interested candidates should read the trade-wise vacancy break-up and document requirements carefully before registering on the apprenticeship portal. HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice clearly states that applications submitted before 4 August 2026 or after 14 August 2026 will not be accepted.

rows.date: Not specified in the official notification

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: HVPNL has notified a total of 114 apprentice seats across three trades. The trade-wise break-up is given below.

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Matriculation (10th) certificate along with the ITI pass certificate (with marks) issued by the ITI Department, relevant to the trade being applied for - Stenographer (English), Draughtsman (Civil), or Lineman. Candidates must ensure their name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth on the Apprenticeship Profile exactly match their original certificates; any mismatch is the candidate's own responsibility.

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per the official notice, selection of successful apprentices will be made purely on a merit basis, according to the marks obtained in the ITI marksheet. Candidates should therefore ensure their ITI mark sheet and profile details are complete and accurate before the closing date.

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents while registering and applying on the apprenticeship portal: Recent photograph Aadhaar number/ID proof (Voter Card, Driving Licence, or Passport accepted where applicable) Matriculation (10th) certificate Original ITI pass certificate (with marks) issued by the ITI Department, for the relevant trade Candidates are advised to complete their Apprenticeship Profile 100% before applying, and to ensure that their name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth match exactly across all original certificates and the online profile.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official apprenticeship portal at apprenticeshipindia.org.in. Register or log in and complete your Apprenticeship Profile to 100%. Locate the HVPNL Stenographer (English)/Draughtsman (Civil)/Lineman Apprentice 2026 opportunity and select the relevant trade. Upload your photograph, Aadhaar/ID proof, Matriculation certificate, and original ITI pass certificate (with marks). Verify all entered details against your original certificates before final submission. Submit the application within the registration window.

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 apply online window is open from 4 August 2026 to 14 August 2026, up to 12:00 noon, on apprenticeshipindia.org.in. Applications submitted before the start date or after the closing time will not be accepted. Direct Link to apply for HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026

content_sections.heading: HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload only their photo, Aadhaar number/ID proof, Matriculation certificate, and the original ITI pass certificate (with marks) issued by the ITI Department. The Apprenticeship Profile should be completed 100% before applying. Name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth on all original certificates must match the Apprenticeship Profile exactly; candidates are solely responsible for any mismatch. Applications submitted before 4 August 2026 or after 14 August 2026 will not be accepted. Selection of apprentices will be made purely on merit based on ITI marksheet marks.

faq.question: Q1. What is HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement of 114 Trade Apprentices by Haryana Vidyut Parsaran Nigam Limited under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for the trades of Stenographer (English), Draughtsman (Civil), and Lineman.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 114 apprentice seats are available: 7 for Stenographer (English), 7 for Draughtsman (Civil), and 100 for Lineman.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application/registration closes on 14 August 2026 at 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Matriculation certificate along with an ITI pass certificate (with marks) in the relevant trade, issued by the ITI Department.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can register and apply online at apprenticeshipindia.org.in between 4 August 2026 and 14 August 2026, by completing their Apprenticeship Profile and uploading the required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is made purely on a merit basis according to the marks obtained in the candidate's ITI marksheet.

faq.question: Q7. Is HVPNL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. This is an apprenticeship engagement under the Apprentices Act, 1961, meant for practical training, and is not a permanent or regular recruitment.
